<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableTree, type TreeNesting } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Heading from './Heading.vue';

interface Section {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  children?: Section[];
}

const props = defineProps<{ nesting: TreeNesting; indentation: number }>();

const outline = ref<Section[]>([
  {
    id: 'start',
    title: 'Getting started',
    children: [
      { id: 'install', title: 'Installation' },
      { id: 'first', title: 'Your first list' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: 'concepts',
    title: 'Concepts',
    children: [
      { id: 'provider', title: 'The provider' },
      {
        id: 'lists',
        title: 'Lists and items',
        children: [
          { id: 'draft', title: 'The draft' },
          { id: 'keys', title: 'Keys' },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
  { id: 'recipes', title: 'Recipes', children: [{ id: 'kanban', title: 'A kanban board' }] },
  { id: 'faq', title: 'FAQ' },
]);

const root = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('root');
// Options as getters: switching them applies to the next drag.
const { items, projected } = makeSortableTree(root, {
  items: outline,
  nesting: () => props.nesting,
  indentation: () => props.indentation,
  maxDepth: 2,
});

// Section numbers from the rendered rows: the dragged one is at its projected depth,
// so the numbers follow the drag.
const numbers = computed(() => {
  const counters: number[] = [];
  return items.value.map((node) => {
    counters.length = node.depth + 1;
    counters[node.depth] = (counters[node.depth] ?? 0) + 1;
    return counters.join('.');
  });
});

const titleOf = (id: unknown) => items.value.find((node) => node.key === id)?.item.title;
const where = computed(() => {
  const value = projected.value;
  if (!value) return 'Drag a section sideways to change its level';
  return `depth ${value.depth} · ${value.parentKey == null ? 'top level' : `in “${titleOf(value.parentKey)}”`}`;
});
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableTree, type Key } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import OrgRow from './OrgRow.vue';
import { createOrg, type Member } from './org';

const org = ref<Member[]>(createOrg());
const collapsed = ref(new Set<Key>());

const INDENT = 22;
const root = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('root');
const { items } = makeSortableTree(root, {
  items: org,
  // This tree keeps its children in `members`.
  getChildren: (member) => member.members,
  setChildren: (member, members) => {
    member.members = members;
  },
  indentation: INDENT,
  // Only teams take members, and a locked team takes no one.
  canNest: (_member, team) => team.kind === 'team' && !team.locked,
  // Teams in teams, but no deeper than that: a team with members can't go below the top.
  maxDepth: 2,
  collapsed,
  // Rows a team shows or hides as it opens or closes slide in and out.
  animateChanges: true,
});

const toggle = (key: Key) => (collapsed.value.has(key) ? collapsed.value.delete(key) : collapsed.value.add(key));
</script>

  return { side: value.side, left: `${((value.depth ?? 0) - props.node.depth) * props.indent}px` };
});

import { ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';

interface Work {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  kind: 'epic' | 'story' | 'task';

const roadmap = ref<Work[]>([
  {
    id: 'checkout',
    title: 'Checkout v2',
    kind: 'epic',
    children: [
      {
        id: 'cards',
        title: 'Saved cards',
        kind: 'story',
        children: [
          { id: 'card-form', title: 'Card form', kind: 'task' },
          { id: 'vault', title: 'Vault API', kind: 'task' },
        ],
      },
      { id: 'apple-pay', title: 'Apple Pay', kind: 'story' },
    ],
  },
  { id: 'onboarding', title: 'Onboarding', kind: 'epic', children: [{ id: 'tour', title: 'Welcome tour', kind: 'story' }] },
]);

const RANK = { epic: 0, story: 1, task: 2 };
let copies = 0;
/** A copy with its whole subtree, every node with a key of its own. */
const copy = (work: Work): Work => ({ ...work, id: `${work.id}-copy-${++copies}`, children: work.children?.map(copy) });

const root = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('root');
const { items, isOver } = makeSortableTree(root, {
  id: 'roadmap',
  items: roadmap,
  // Same group as the backlog: nodes move between the two, subtrees included.
  group: 'work',
  indentation: 20,
  // Stories go into epics, tasks into stories or epics.
  canNest: (work, parent) => RANK[parent.kind] < RANK[work.kind],
  maxDepth: 2,
  // Hold Alt while dragging into the backlog to copy instead.
  clone: copy,
});
</script>
